title: No-tautological-tests rule: also ban tests that check whether agent instruction files exist
outcome: The rule's first bullet covers tests that check the presence of the repository's agent instruction files, not only their content, so a test asserting that a command file exists or is gone can't be read as allowed.
acceptance: The first bullet of '## No tautological tests' in AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md reads 'reads, pins or compares the content or presence of' (or equivalent), identical in both files
No automated check of the rule's wording is added
